title: THE TROPHY CASE
why: His yes to suggestion 33. The stash has a new TROPHIES button beside ARMORY. It opens a trophy case, a shelf of eight plaques: FIRST OUT for an extraction, GHOST for walking out unspotted, MOTHERLODE for a $20,000 haul, CENTURION for 100 kills with one gun, FORGED for keeping a MK III gun, FULL ARMORY for every gun in the codex, GOLD HUNTER for killing the golden enemy and OVERSEER DOWN for killing the Overseer. Earned plaques are lit in bronze, silver or gold with the day they were earned; the rest are dark and say in caps what it takes. The first six are worked out from what your save already says, so an older save has its shelf the first time the stash is drawn. The last two are given the moment the kill happens, with a TROPHY EARNED callout. A trophy is kept for good and changes nothing in the game.
now: The stash has a trophy case of eight plaques, lit when earned.
